examples.label: Glossary of publishing terms
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-dl" site="Global" class="mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-5">
<.component component_name="chelekom-dt" site="Global">Draft <.component component_name="chelekom-dd" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 border-s-2 border-gray-200 ps-3 dark:border-gray-700"> A page that has been saved but is not visible to visitors. Every draft keeps its own preview link, so you can share work in progress before it goes live.
<.component component_name="chelekom-dt" site="Global">Snippet <.component component_name="chelekom-dd" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 border-s-2 border-gray-200 ps-3 dark:border-gray-700"> A saved group of blocks you can drop into any page. Edit the snippet once and every page that uses it picks up the change.
<.component component_name="chelekom-dt" site="Global">Layout <.component component_name="chelekom-dd" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 border-s-2 border-gray-200 ps-3 dark:border-gray-700"> The frame around your content: header, footer and anything else that repeats. Pages choose a layout instead of redrawing the chrome themselves.
